description: Vodovodna infrastruktura v občini Cankova is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA CANKOVA. Record of data on water supply infrastructure in the municipality of Cankova in the Collective Cadastre of Commercial Public Infrastructure of the Surveying and Mapping Authority of the Republic of Slovenia. Coverage: OBČINA CANKOVA. The portal shows the English title as "Water infrastructure in the municipality of Cankova" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA CANKOVA. Its keywords include vodovod, vodovodno omrežje, vodovodna infrastruktura. The listing shows 3 download or service links in PDF, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
